subtopic: Buying and Redeeming Mutual Fund Shares
source_evidence: The purchase price is the next calculated NAV, plus any fees charged at the time of purchase.
answer: When you buy mutual fund shares, you buy them from the fund itself or through a broker or investment adviser—not from another investor on a national securities market. The purchase price is based on the next calculated net asset value (NAV), with any purchase fees added. When you redeem shares, you sell them back to the fund at the next calculated NAV, with any redemption fees subtracted.
